photoobj_canonical.name: photoobj_canonical
photoobj_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid AS objid,
  p.ra AS ra,
  p.dec AS dec,
  p.g AS g
FROM photoobj p
WHERE p.clean = 1
  AND p.objid IS NOT NULL
  AND p.ra IS NOT NULL
  AND p.dec IS NOT NULL
  AND p.g IS NOT NULL
photoobj_canonical.description: Canonical cleaned projection of photo objects exposing identifying, positional, band magnitudes, and observational metadata for each photo object row.

specobj_canonical.name: specobj_canonical
specobj_canonical.body_sql:
SELECT
  s.specobjid,
  s.bestobjid,
  s.z,
  s.class
FROM
  specobj s
specobj_canonical.description: Canonical projection of spectroscopic objects with primary linking to the best photometric object, redshift, and class/subclass for spectroscopic classification.

photo_with_spec_link.name: photo_with_spec_link
photo_with_spec_link.body_sql:
SELECT
  p.objid,
  p.ra,
  p.dec,
  p.g,
  s.specobjid,
  s.z,
  s.class
FROM photoobj p
JOIN specobj s
  ON s.bestobjid = p.objid
photo_with_spec_link.description: Denormalized join between photo objects and their linked spectroscopic objects (via specobj.bestobjid), exposing photo identifiers and positions alongside spectroscopic redshift and class. One row per photoobj that has a matching specobj.bestobjid.
